content.text:
Yes.
Agents can use the built‑in web_search tool and return the final answer in JSON by setting `"responseFormat": { "type": "json" }` in the agent definition.
[Agent tools](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/tools#available-tools) & [Response format](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/api#response-format)
